newsitem.title: USA: Osicom sees rev growth from new sales pact.
newsitem.headline: Osicom sees rev growth from new sales pact.

text.p: Osicom Technologies Inc Tuesday said it expanded its distribution pact with Tech Data Corp, a move that Osicom believes will boost sales $10 million to $15 million over the next 12 months.

Tech Data, a distributor serving more than 50,000 computer equipment resellers and dealers in North America, Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, will sell Osicom's complete line of internetworking and printer server products.
The initial focus will promote Osicom's ROUTERmate and MatchBox product lines due to the high demand in the market for remote network access and switching technologies.

"Osicom currently has sales greater than $20 million through indirect channels and with the size of the market and the product scope covered by this agreement, we expect to see revenues from this channel grow an additional $10 to $15 million dollars over the next 12 months," John Hwang, president of Osicom's internetworking sales, said in a statement.
